decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote-tags.txt absence of v0.9.5 plus sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main refspecs to tie attempt-1 failure to missing tag distribution, explicitly rejecting network/typo explanations.

Combines dsh-version.txt rc.2 with compat-table v0.9.7→alpha.1 to explain the newer-API plugin lacking useConversation on the older host; states direction explicitly and denies install/restart as compatibility proof.

Keeps rc.2, selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification plus additive rc.2 note, notices v0.9.3 is also absent, gives the pinned #v0.9.3 command only after maintainer publication, invents no SHA and rejects host upgrade.

Proposes explicit git push <remote> refs/tags/<tag> to every mirror grounded in the branch-only sync script, with ls-remote tag-resolution verification and release gating; branch sync alone called insufficient.
Routes README pins by dsh --version with a compatibility table (rc.1/rc.2 to v0.9.3, alpha.1 to v0.9.7), rejects newest-tag defaults and untested broad ranges.
